title: Web: Week weight
description: The `weight` part of GET /api/coach/week (null when no phase was active during the week). source check_in: the numbers the week's check-in stored (trend at the week's end, the trend the day before it, the weekly rate between them, its band and position). source so_far: the week not judged yet, its 7-day rate ending today (rate_window last_7_days, as Home shows it) against the band for the week. days: the week's days so far (7 once it is over). series: the day before the week (where its rate starts) to the last day so far: weigh-ins (outliers marked), the 7-day trend and the band corridor rising from that day's trend at the band's low and high rate (null when the week isn't judged against a band: glycogen window or no band).
